source.name: GYM GEAR STRENGHT TRAINING RESISTANCE BANDS - PROJECT 100 MASTER VISUAL RECOGNITION DATABASE (COMPREHENSIVE) (1).pdf

bundles.name: Juggernaut
bundles.use: Chest presses, standing presses and horizontal pushing.

bundles.name: Titan
bundles.use: Rows, lat pull-downs and posterior-chain work.

bundles.name: Enforcer
bundles.use: Overhand/underhand extensions, press-downs and lockout work.

bundles.name: Viper
bundles.use: Shoulder raises, drop sets and finisher work.

bundles.name: Scalpel
bundles.use: Deltoid flys, precise isolation and warm-up sets.

bundles.name: Twin Cobras
bundles.use: Two separate bands for unilateral curls, one band per hand with individual factory clips.

bundle_modifiers.tape: Black Renfrew cloth tape at the joint loops, replacing rigid plastic ties.
bundle_modifiers.connection: Eight JRSGS carabiners in the documented bundle setup. Twin Cobras use individual factory clips.

records.name: KUZARO · Multi-band setup
records.description: Yellow connection webbing with black KUZARO lettering and thick black D-rings. The supplied manifest lists six tubing grades from light gray to solid black.

records.name: HPYGN Heavy-Duty Compression System
records.description: Gray-black multi-layered bands with black nylon shrouds and carabiner clips. Recorded short-band configuration: two 65 lb bands, doubled and shortened at the low Iron Tower anchor, routed into the Tribe bar’s rotating eyelets. Their nominal ratings total 130 lb; resistance changes with stretch.

records.name: BLUSLM Ergonomic Tricep Rope
records.description: Extra-long twin black braided nylon arms, a chrome connection collar and large molded black palm-flare stops.

records.name: HXD-ERGO Biomechanical Handles
records.description: Asymmetric black ergonomic grip molds, flat nylon straps with a blue-and-white shield logo, and integrated fixed black carabiners.

records.name: INNSTAR High-Traction Stirrup Handles
records.description: Triangular black nylon stirrup handles with black carabiners. The ABS grip cores have anti-slip silicone honeycomb texture; white INNSTAR lettering runs along the straps.

records.name: Angles90 Camo Pull-Up Grips
records.description: Bright orange curved handles on flat black nylon slings, with black A90 GRIPS lettering along the outer curve.

records.name: THEFITGUY Single-Arm Tricep Rope
records.description: Single-arm black braided rope with a zinc-plated top snap hook. The distinctive red bell-shaped palm stop carries debossed thefitguy lettering.

records.name: MANUEKLEAR Neoprene Multi-Grip Handles
records.description: Extra-wide matte-gray neoprene/nylon straps with one silver D-ring. Sewn upper, middle and lower grip pockets provide three positions; the side tag has a yellow-and-white logo.

records.name: Tribe Lifting Modular Resistance Bar
records.description: Polished chrome knurled bar with three threaded sections and independent rotating ball-bearing swivel rings at both ends.

records.name: HPYGN Heavy Pilates Structural Bar
records.description: Black steel bar covered in dense non-slip black foam. Its nylon terminal straps have distinctive red edge stitching.

records.name: THEFITGUY Ultimate Extension Straps
records.description: Flat black nylon extension straps with silver steel D-rings at both ends. Bright red zigzag and box reinforcement runs along their faces; the black fabric tag reads thefitguy.

records.name: THEFITGUY Sled Pulling Belt & Straps Kit
records.description: Wide padded black neoprene waist harness with two steel D-rings, two 9.8-foot pulling straps and four silver oval snap hooks. Red diamond and X stitching identifies the belt and straps.

records.name: Oak-Sports Heavy-Duty Carabiners
records.description: Bright silver symmetrical oval steel frames with black textured screw-lock gates. The equipment manifest lists a 25 kN / 5,600 lb rating.

records.name: JRSGS Rock Locking Clips
records.description: Asymmetric matte-black D-shaped frames with screw-lock barrels. Variant A has a metallic-red barrel; Variant B has a matte-black barrel. The manifest lists 25 kN.

records.name: Neoprene Cable / Bundle Management Sleeves
records.description: Flexible black wraps enclosing multi-band arrays. The reversible split-seam sleeves use a continuous hook-and-loop closure for bundle management and contact shielding.

records.name: VEHICLEX Axle Tie-Down Straps
records.description: Thick black webbing with gold/silver triangular steel D-rings and sliding protective sleeves. A red rectangular patch with white VEHICLEX lettering identifies the sleeve.

records.name: NILIGHT Soft Loop Anchor Straps
records.description: Short black polyester choke-loop straps with repeating white X/diamond reinforcement. The small white/black/red warning tag carries the Nilight emblem.

records.name: MIAOKE Tactical Hardware Duffel
records.description: Black utility duffel/backpack with red zipper tracks and red diamond elastic side cording. The matching clear-panel organizer is labeled WASHBAG.

records.name: jooeer 3-in-1 Nested Foam Roller Set
records.description: Outer: 18 × 5.5 in black high-density foam roller with a pyramid/spiked texture. Middle: 18 × 3.9 in neon-orange roller with linear ridges. Core: 18 × 1.57 in orange segmented massage stick with matte-gray grips and a black lanyard.
